cmd:
set -eu; mkdir -p /conduit/pipelines; envsubst < /conduit/cdc-to-bus.yaml.tmpl > /conduit/pipelines/cdc-to-bus.yaml; slot=$(sed -nE 's/.*logrepl\.slotName:[[:space:]]*"?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"?.*/\1/p' /conduit/pipelines/cdc-to-bus.yaml | head -n 1); pub=$(sed -nE 's/.*logrepl\.publicationName:[[:space:]]*"?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"?.*/\1/p' /conduit/pipelines/cdc-to-bus.yaml | head -n 1); if [ -n "$slot" ]; then [ -n "$pub" ] || { echo "conduit: slot $slot has no logrepl.publicationName" >&2; exit 1; }; state=$(printf '%s
' "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT '1' FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot' AND wal_status = 'lost'), '0') || ',' || COALESCE((SELECT '1' FROM pg_publication WHERE pubname = :'pub' AND obj_description(oid, 'pg_publication') = 'slot_reset_pending'), '0');" | psql "$DATABASE_URL" -XAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v slot="$slot" -v pub="$pub"); if [ "$state" != "0,0" ]; then echo "conduit: slot $slot recovery needed ($state); recreating slot and signalling readers to rebuild" >&2; i=0; until curl -fsS "$MESH_EVENTS_URL/v1.0/healthz/outbound" >/dev/null; do i=$((i + 1)); [ "$i" -lt 30 ] || { echo "conduit: mesh-events at $MESH_EVENTS_URL not ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; printf '%s
' "COMMENT ON PUBLICATION :"pub" IS 'slot_reset_pending';" "SELECT pg_drop_replication_slot(slot_name) FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot' AND wal_status = 'lost';" "SELECT pg_create_logical_replication_slot(:'slot', 'pgoutput') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot');" | psql "$DATABASE_URL" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v slot="$slot" -v pub="$pub"; curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data '{"__table":"slot_reset"}' "$MESH_EVENTS_URL/v1.0/publish/redis-streams/cdc-events"; printf '%s
' "COMMENT ON PUBLICATION :"pub" IS NULL;" | psql "$DATABASE_URL" -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v pub="$pub"; fi; fi; exec /app/conduit run

entrypoint.do: let base = ($env.BAYT_LOCAL_WORK_DIR? | default $nu.temp-dir); let dir = ($base | path join $'conduit-($nu.pid)-(random int 1000..9999)'); mkdir ($dir | path join 'pipelines') ($dir | path join 'connectors'); let conn = (which conduit-connector-http | first | get path); cp -f $conn ($dir | path join 'connectors' ($conn | path basename)); let cfg = ($dir | path join 'pipelines/cdc-to-bus.yaml'); open --raw 'services/cdc/pipelines/cdc-to-dapr.yaml' | str replace -a '${DATABASE_URL}' $env.DATABASE_URL | str replace -a '${MESH_EVENTS_URL}' $env.MESH_EVENTS_URL | save -f $cfg; let raw = (open --raw $cfg); let slot = ($raw | parse -r 'logrepl\.slotName:\s*"?(?<name>[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"?' | get -o 0.name | default ''); let pub = ($raw | parse -r 'logrepl\.publicationName:\s*"?(?<name>[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"?' | get -o 0.name | default ''); if $slot != '' { if $pub == '' { error make { msg: $'conduit: slot ($slot) has no logrepl.publicationName' } }; let state = ("SELECT COALESCE((SELECT '1' FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot' AND wal_status = 'lost'), '0') || ',' || COALESCE((SELECT '1' FROM pg_publication WHERE pubname = :'pub' AND obj_description(oid, 'pg_publication') = 'slot_reset_pending'), '0');" | ^psql $env.DATABASE_URL -XAt -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v $'slot=($slot)' -v $'pub=($pub)' | str trim); if $state != '0,0' { print -e $'conduit: slot ($slot) recovery needed (($state)); recreating slot and signalling readers to rebuild'; mut ready = false; for _ in 1..30 { if (try { http get $'($env.MESH_EVENTS_URL)/v1.0/healthz/outbound'; true } catch { false }) { $ready = true; break }; sleep 1sec }; if not $ready { error make { msg: $'conduit: mesh-events at ($env.MESH_EVENTS_URL) not ready' } }; (["COMMENT ON PUBLICATION :\"pub\" IS 'slot_reset_pending';" "SELECT pg_drop_replication_slot(slot_name) FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot' AND wal_status = 'lost';" "SELECT pg_create_logical_replication_slot(:'slot', 'pgoutput') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_name = :'slot');"] | str join (char nl)) | ^psql $env.DATABASE_URL -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v $'slot=($slot)' -v $'pub=($pub)'; http post --content-type text/plain $'($env.MESH_EVENTS_URL)/v1.0/publish/redis-streams/cdc-events' '{"__table":"slot_reset"}'; "COMMENT ON PUBLICATION :\"pub\" IS NULL;" | ^psql $env.DATABASE_URL -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v $'pub=($pub)' } }; exec conduit run --db.type inmemory --pipelines.path ($dir | path join 'pipelines') --connectors.path ($dir | path join 'connectors') --api.http.address $"127.0.0.1:($env.CONDUIT_API_HTTP_ADDRESS_PORT)" --api.grpc.address '127.0.0.1:0'
